Scottsdale to Oro Valley and northwest Tucson

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Northwest Tucson and Oro Valley (85704) showcase the Sonoran Desert at its most beautiful, with the Santa Catalina Mountains providing a dramatic backdrop to world-class resorts, championship golf, and outdoor recreation. Catalina State Park and nearby Biosphere 2 add natural and scientific attractions. Our transportation connects Phoenix travelers to this stunning desert landscape.

Neighborhood guide

The 85704 area spans northwest Tucson into Oro Valley, nestled against the western slopes of the Santa Catalina Mountains. Luxury resorts along the foothills offer destination experiences with golf, spa, and dining. Catalina State Park provides hiking access including trails to Romero Pools. Biosphere 2, the famous enclosed ecosystem, offers tours and science programs. La Encantada and other shopping centers serve the affluent communities. The area combines natural beauty with resort amenities.

Getting there from Scottsdale

A day run south from Scottsdale, booked by the hour

Oro Valley sits at the top of Tucson, so the drive is the same run down the 10 plus the run through the city. Groups pairing a Scottsdale resort with a Catalina foothills one book the transfer as a single leg rather than two separate airport trips.

Frequently asked questions

Do you provide transportation to Biosphere 2?

Yes! Biosphere 2 is a fascinating science destination in the foothills north of Tucson. We provide comfortable transportation for tours of this unique enclosed ecosystem research facility.

Can you arrange resort transfers in Northwest Tucson?

We offer VIP transfer service to the luxury resorts in the Catalina foothills and the Oro Valley corridor. Our vehicles match the resort experience with professional service from airport to property.

Do you offer golf transportation in Tucson?

Absolutely! The Tucson area has outstanding golf across the Catalina foothills and Oro Valley. We transport golfers and their equipment to the courses their group has booked.

Can you combine Phoenix and Tucson resort visits?

Yes! We provide transportation for multi-city Arizona resort experiences. Enjoy Scottsdale resorts and Tucson's mountain properties on the same trip with comfortable transportation between destinations.
